run_pcd_inference: run 3D object detection inference on a point cloud file using a config and checkpoint
init_detector_model: build a 3D detector model from a config file and checkpoint for a given device
inference_on_point_cloud: test a single point cloud file with a loaded 3D detector model
show_meshlab_results: visualize 3D detection bounding box results in MeshLab and save to output directory
review_main_pipeline: review the main CLI pipeline that parses args, initializes a detector, runs inference, and shows results
